senses.gloss: King of Adiabene, father of Monobazus and Izates.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 46:10">Gen. R. s. 46</cite> (Jos. Ant. XX, 2, 1 Monobazus), v. <cite ref="M00530"><he>מוּנְבָּז</he></cite>

senses.gloss: king of Egypt (Ptolemy II Philadelphus), during whose reign the Septuagint is said to have been produced.
units: <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 1:7">Treat. Sof’rim I, 7</cite> <he>מעשה בחמשה … לת׳ המלך וכ׳</he> it occurred that five elders wrote the Torah in Greek for King Ptolemy, and that day was as ominous for Israel as &c.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 1:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>שוב מעשה בת׳ וכ׳</he> another time it occurred that King P. assembled seventy-two elders &c.; <cite ref="Megillah 9a">Meg. 9ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 9a">Ib.</cite>; Y. ib. I, 71ᵈ bot. <he>שלשה … לת׳ המלך</he> thirteen passages the scholars changed (in their translation) for King P.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 11:7">Gen. XI, 7</cite>) <he>זה … לת׳ המלך</he> this is one of the texts they changed for King P.; a. fr.
